record.field:
Regaber SKYplatform API · Odoo Integration

1) Connection (Remote Control)

Type: REST

Base URL: https://api.skyplatform.matwatertech.com

connection_params (JSON):

{
  "username": "user@example.com",
    "password": "********",
    "project_id": 285428
}
  • Get Token → performs POST /Token (form-urlencoded, grant_type=password) and stores bag["access_token"].
  • Subsequent requests must include the header: Authorization: Bearer <access_token>.
  • Token validity: 1 day (1 209 599 seconds). Not persisted; each execution requires a new login.

2) Element Tree

Project (Type 1)
└── ControlZone / Area (Type 2)
    └── SKYreg Concentrator (Type 200)
        └── SKYreg Hydrant (Type 221)
            └── SKYreg WaterMeter (Type 207)
SKYmeter NB-IoT (Type 3106)
└── SKYmeterNBIoT WaterMeter (Type 3107)

Use GET /TreeNode to discover the full tree and obtain element IDs.

3) Counter Endpoints

Device TypeEndpoint
SKYreg WaterMeterGET /SKYreg/WaterMeter/LastValue/?id={id}
SKYreg Hydrant (water meter)GET /SKYreg/Hydrant/WaterMeter/LastValue/?id={id}
SKYmeter NB-IoT WaterMeterGET /SKYmeterNBIoT/WaterMeter/LastValue/?id={id}

4) Response Format

SKYreg / SKYreg Hydrant:

{
  "TreeNodeId": 178089,
  "Type": 12,
  "Units": "m³",
  "LastValue": {
    "Value": 66404.0,
    "DateTime": "01/01/2024 08:00"
  }
}

SKYmeter NB-IoT:

{
  "TreeNodeId": 934067,
  "Units": "m³",
  "LastValue": {
    "Value": 288.0,
    "DateTime": "01/01/2024 08:00"
  }
}

DateTime format: dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm (European format).

5) Odoo Configuration (via wua_remotecontrol_rest_regaber)

In each wua.waterconnection:

  • Regaber TreeNode ID: Integer ID from GET /TreeNode.
  • Regaber Device Type: skyreg, skyreg_hydrant, or skymeter_nbiot.
  • project_id in connection_params is optional but recommended. If set, discovery/import is limited to that project.

6) Available Procedures

  • Regaber: Get Tree Nodes — Downloads the full element tree and creates a JSON attachment.
  • Regaber: Get Last Readings — Used internally by the WUA module to fetch the last counter value for each configured waterconnection.
  • Regaber: Daily Sync — Used by the generic MDM sensor integration (mdm.measurement.device / mdm.measurement.device.sensor) to fetch the last counter value of each configured sensor.

7) MDM Device/Sensor Configuration

As an alternative to the ``wua.waterconnection`` integration, a Regaber element can be configured directly on a generic mdm.measurement.device and its mdm.measurement.device.sensor, so that Regaber: Daily Sync populates mdm.measurement.device.sensor.reading.

In Device (mdm.measurement.device):

{
  "device_type": "skyreg"
}
  • device_type: Default Regaber device type for all sensors of this device (optional; used when the sensor does not set its own). One of skyreg, skyreg_hydrant, skymeter_nbiot.

In Sensor (mdm.measurement.device.sensor):

{
  "node_id": 178089,
  "device_type": "skyreg"
}
  • node_id: Regaber TreeNode ID (required), obtained from GET /TreeNode.
  • device_type: Overrides the device's default; falls back to skyreg if neither is set.

# SKYplatform uses Bearer token authentication. # POST /Token with application/x-www-form-urlencoded, grant_type=password. remote = self.remote_id cfg = {} try: cfg = json.loads(remote.connection_params or '{}') except Exception: cfg = {} username = (cfg.get('username') or '').strip() password = (cfg.get('password') or '').strip() if not username or not password: raise Exception( "Missing Regaber credentials: set username/password " "in connection_params.") url = (base_url or '').rstrip('/') + '/Token' token_data = { 'username': username, 'password': password, 'grant_type': 'password', } resp = request_retry( 'POST', url, data=token_data, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'}, timeout=timeout, ) if resp.status_code >= 400: raise Exception( "Regaber token request failed: %s %s" % ( resp.status_code, resp.text)) try: j = resp.json() except Exception as e: raise Exception("Failed to parse Regaber token response: %s" % str(e)) access_token = j.get('access_token') or '' if not access_token: raise Exception( "Regaber login OK but no access_token in response: %s" % str(j)) bag['access_token'] = access_token bag['token_type'] = j.get('token_type', 'bearer') bag['expires_in'] = j.get('expires_in') bag['token_username'] = j.get('userName', '')

import time from datetime import datetime as _datetime
Remote = self.remote_id SensorModel = env['mdm.measurement.device.sensor']
plan = bag.get('sensors_plan') or [] access_token = bag.get('access_token') if not access_token: raise Exception("Missing access_token in bag. Run 'Get Token' first.")
headers = { 'Authorization': 'Bearer %s' % access_token, 'Accept': 'application/json', } api_base = (base_url or '').rstrip('/') endpoint_map = { 'skyreg': '/SKYreg/WaterMeter/LastValue/', 'skyreg_hydrant': '/SKYreg/Hydrant/WaterMeter/LastValue/', 'skymeter_nbiot': '/SKYmeterNBIoT/WaterMeter/LastValue/', } total_upserts = 0 total_errors = 0 items = [] for sensor_plan in plan: sensor_id = sensor_plan['sensor_id'] device_id = sensor_plan['device_id'] node_id = sensor_plan['node_id'] device_type = sensor_plan['device_type'] sensor_record = SensorModel.browse(sensor_id) endpoint = endpoint_map.get(device_type) if not endpoint: items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'node_id': node_id, 'error': 'Unknown device_type: %s' % device_type, }) total_errors += 1 continue url = '%s%s?id=%s' % (api_base, endpoint, node_id) try: resp = request_retry('GET', url, headers=headers, timeout=timeout) code = resp.status_code full_url = getattr(resp, 'url', url) if code >= 400: items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'node_id': node_id, 'status': code, 'error': (resp.text or '')[:400], 'url': full_url, }) total_errors += 1 continue payload = resp.json() or {} last_value_obj = payload.get('LastValue') or {} value = last_value_obj.get('Value') date_str = last_value_obj.get('DateTime') or '' if value is None or value == '' or not date_str: items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'node_id': node_id, 'status': code, 'error': 'Missing Value/DateTime in response', 'url': full_url, }) total_errors += 1 continue try: dt = _datetime.strptime(date_str.strip(), '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M') date_iso = dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') value_float = float(value) except (ValueError, TypeError) as e: items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'node_id': node_id, 'status': code, 'error': 'Parse error: %s' % str(e), 'url': full_url, }) total_errors += 1 continue Remote.upsert( 'mdm.measurement.device.sensor.reading', {'sensor_id': sensor_record.id, 'measurement_time': date_iso}, {'value': value_float, 'device_id': device_id} ) total_upserts += 1 items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'node_id': node_id, 'device_type': device_type, 'status': 200, 'url': full_url, 'value': value_float, 'date': date_iso, 'units': payload.get('Units', ''), }) except Exception as e: items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'node_id': node_id, 'status': -1, 'error': str(e), }) total_errors += 1 time.sleep(0.2) audit = { 'executed_at': fields.Datetime.now(), 'total_upserts': total_upserts, 'total_errors': total_errors, 'items': items, } b64 = base64.b64encode(json.dumps(audit, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2).encode('utf-8')) fname = 'regaber_readings_%s.json' % fields.Datetime.now().replace( ':', '').replace('-', '').replace(' ', '_') att = env['ir.attachment'].create({ 'name': fname, 'datas_fname': fname, 'datas': b64, 'mimetype': 'application/json', 'res_model': 'remotecontrol', 'res_id': Remote.id, }) Remote.message_post( body=u"[Regaber] upserts=%s errors=%s" % (total_upserts, total_errors), attachment_ids=[att.id], ) bag['upserts'] = total_upserts bag['errors'] = total_errors bag['audit_attachment_id'] = att.id
